free_tier.stated: not stated: https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/kubernetes prints no free allowance, credit or price for ACK
free_tier.notes: the ACK pricing page https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/kubernetes/pricing shows a 'Get it Free' link to the console and states no amount, unit or period

limits.value: ACK bills per cluster and per worker node; the product page states no rate, so the number still rests on the card

identity_cost.detail: an Alibaba Cloud international-site account: 'Requires an email address for registration, plus a mobile number from outside the Chinese mainland (including Hong Kong (China), Macao (China), and Taiwan (China)) for security verification.'; a payment method before any order, quoted 'you must also complete security authentication and add payment information before you can buy paid cloud services in regions outside the Chinese mainland or activate the free trial of most paid services', and virtual cards are refused, quoted 'the system does not support using virtual credit cards for payment verification or card binding'; a passport or driver's license only for cloud resources located in the Chinese mainland; the mobile number must belong to the Country/Region chosen at registration, quoted 'The number must belong to the Country/Region that you selected.'; the Chinese mainland is not a registration region, quoted 'The Alibaba Cloud international site does not support selecting the Chinese mainland as the registration region, and does not support binding a mobile number of the Chinese mainland.'

confidence_note: the product page was read on 2026-10-22. It is a feature page, not a price list: no cluster fee, no free tier and no per-node rate appears on it, so the record's free-tier claim cannot be settled from its own URL
